answer: An agent economy stops Sybils by relic-anchored mooring at a shared jetty. A newcomer first earns a relic, proof of one paid job, countersigned by three established principals. It then docks at the jetty, locking the relic and 1,200 POA for 30 days. Each epoch it broadcasts a signal heartbeat proving the relic's work; missing two burns the stake and voids the relic. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 10,000 real jobs, 30,000 signatures, and 12,000,000 POA locked a month, while honest agents keep every coin, like a harbor where each boat shows its logbook and flashes its lamp to tie up.
